summary: Focused frontend/engine testing of the new 'SKINNY JAB' pickup. Wrote a Node-based engine test (10/10 pass) covering snapshot shape, spawn-safety vs obstacle bands, reset semantics, crash payload, and setSkinnyJabChance validation. Ran playwright UI runs to verify no page errors and that the skinny-jab-pop element mounts and remains hidden (opacity 0) until triggered. Could not naturally collect a syringe in browser under automated keyboard-only control (pigeon can't be steered vertically), but all internal state transitions the spec depends on are proven at the engine level.

coverage: Skinny Jab spawns during a run when SKINNY_JAB_CHANCE=1 (and only after fatChips>=SKINNY_JAB_MIN_FAT — verified indirectly via safe-placement scan)
Skinny Jab NEVER overlaps an active obstacle band across 4000 simulation steps (full-bounds check with pad=14)
reset() clears jab.active, pop timestamp, chipCount, skinnyJabCount

verified_behaviours: App boots with 0 page errors; only benign RNW 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning (pre-existing per iteration 11).
GameScreen mounts <JabView/> and <PopText/> unconditionally; skinny-jab-pop testid element present in DOM at run start with opacity 0 and translateX -999 (inactive state).
JabView and PopText both have pointerEvents='none' — never block the flap-area Pressable (verified in source).

Engine correctly separates fatChips (drives fat level & pigeon radius) from chipCount (HUD/score/leaderboard). Jab collection sets `fatChips = 0` while chipCount is untouched — spec matches code lines 456-457 of engine.js.

engine.reset() clears jab.active, popT, fatChips, chipCount, skinnyJabCount — no leftover state on PLAY AGAIN. Verified via test 4 and by browser check: after PLAY AGAIN the pop opacity is 0 and chip-hud reads '0'.
isJabPosSafe replicates isChipPosSafe with the correct sprite radius (SKINNY_JAB_SIZE/2) + pad=14 — the safe-placement scan over 4000 steps observed 0 overlaps.
PopText window is dtp in [0, 1100]ms with scale ramp then float-up + fade — matches spec 'scales/pops, floats up and fades within ~1 second'.
createEngine wires onSkinnyJab -> cbRef.onSkinnyJab -> Audio.pop() (line 132-134 GameScreen). Feather burst + skinnyJabCount++ happen on collection (engine.js 458-461).

distance/score/speed/gravity/collision math are untouched by the jab branch (only fatChips is mutated) — regression risk is confined to fat-level rendering, which correctly reads from fatLevelFor(fatChips).
critical_code_review_comments: Positive: clean split of chipCount vs fatChips is exactly what the spec requires; no double-counting, no leaderboard side-effects.
Positive: safe-placement algorithm walks 5 vertical candidates around the gap centre and gives up silently if none fit — matches spec 'skip if no safe spot'. Verified 0 overlaps in 4000 sim steps.

Minor: in GameScreen.PopText, when the world clock resets (new run) but the previous run's popT lingered briefly, `w.t - pop` could go negative for one frame — already handled with `dtp < 0` guard. Fine.
Minor: JabView + PopText are always mounted (invisible when inactive) which is the correct pattern for reanimated shared-value transforms; no unmount/remount jank.
Minor (pre-existing, not related to this feature): RN Web 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning surfaces on every mount — worth moving to style.pointerEvents in a future cleanup.
action_items: Before shipping to production, revert /app/frontend/src/config.js CONFIG.SKINNY_JAB_CHANCE back to 0.005 and CONFIG.SKINNY_JAB_MIN_FAT back to 10 (currently set to TEMP-TEST values 1.0 / 1). File has a clear 'TEMP-TEST (prod 0.005)' comment already.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for engine-level Skinny Jab spec; UI: mount/reset verified, live-collection visual not exercised (no spatial control in headless automation)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The Skinny Jab feature is fully covered at engine level by /app/frontend/tests/engine_skinny_jab.test.mjs (run via `node --experimental-loader=/tmp/loader.mjs tests/engine_skinny_jab.test.mjs` from /app/frontend). If you want a live UI capture of the POP! text, drive the game manually (a human) or expose engineRef on window in a dev flag so playwright can teleport pigeon.y to snap onto jab.y. Remember to revert CONFIG.SKINNY_JAB_CHANCE (1.0 -> 0.005) and SKINNY_JAB_MIN_FAT (1 -> 10) before production. Prior iterations 9/10/11 (leaderboard/visuals/ads) are already green — no regression seen in this run.
